phases.message: I'm Imani Boateng. This is my mail: my airline's letters, my card's and a message from my colleague Tomas. Read every message. Don't do anything yet: I'll send you to my card, my trips and the airline's claims site.
This is my Cardhollow card. Read the baggage benefit and my statement, every page. Don't do anything yet.
This is Tripcairn, my trips. Read my trips and their flights. Then go to the airline's claims site.

This is Aerolark baggage claims. Read its rules, my report, my claim file on every page and my bags. Then put the right receipt lines in my written complaint, each with a reason, and ask for the bag fee refund where it is owed. Leave out what the airline's rules do not pay. Then tell me what you claimed and what you left out, and why.

benefit.text: Cardhollow card benefits (invented). Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Imani Boateng, card ending 4417. Topics: index, baggage. Your statement is in read_statement.

Baggage delay benefit. When a checked bag is delayed more than 6 hours, the card pays up to 100 dollars a trip for essential purchases made before the bag arrives, on the receipts you send. Items it pays are not to be claimed again from the airline or anyone else: the card takes over your claim for them. Claim BD-7731 paid 59.00 dollars on 5 October 2026 for the Atlantico Outdoor receipt of 27 September. It paid nothing else for the trip.

rules.text: Aerolark baggage claims (invented). Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Topics: index, carriage, complaint, expenses, limit, bagfee. This site gives the airline's rules for a delayed bag on an international flight. Read the claim file with read_claim_file.

Carriage. The rules of the Montreal Convention apply when the ticket's departure and destination are in two countries that are parties to it, as the United States and Portugal are. A flight entirely inside one country is not under it, and a claim for a domestic delay follows the airline's own conditions. Flights AL 41 and AL 42 are international.

The written complaint. For a delayed bag the complaint must be in writing and reach Aerolark within 21 days from the day the bag was placed at the passenger's disposal. If none is made in time, no claim can be brought, except for fraud by the airline. The day counts from delivery, not from arrival. File each expense line with claim_expense.

What Aerolark pays. Reasonable cost of the essentials a passenger had to buy while the bag was missing, from arrival to delivery: toiletries, medicines, basic clothing, a charger, and what a work engagement needs. Not paid: things the passenger would have bought anyway, such as food; luxury goods or a new wardrobe; anything bought after the bag was delivered; an item another source has paid, such as a card's baggage benefit; purchases for another traveller whose own bag arrived; costs not caused by the bag; and a trip whose 21 days have ended.

The limit. Liability for baggage, for loss, damage or delay together, is 1,519 Special Drawing Rights for each passenger, as revised by ICAO from 28 December 2024 (1,288 from 28 December 2019). It is about 2,000 dollars. Aerolark is not liable for a delay if it shows it took all measures that could reasonably be required, or that taking them was impossible.

The checked bag fee. Under the Department of Transportation's refund rule, 14 CFR 260.5, a bag not delivered within 15 hours on an international flight of 12 hours or less (12 hours on a domestic flight, 30 on a longer international one) earns a refund of the fee, if the passenger filed a baggage report. It is paid in 7 business days to a card. Request it with request_bag_fee_refund, one bag at a time. A fee already refunded, and a bag that arrived on time, are not refunded again.
